all_learned_arm_windows_vs_klt.note: Exact-fallback ties map byte-identical learned bags to KLT and are not independent replays.

learned_vs_matched_gftt.interpretation: Matched GFTT follows the same rescue/harm direction as learned relative to KLT; learned source necessity is not established.

blocking_result: A02 XFeat and SP+LG, as well as both matched-GFTT controls, show repeatable large fixed-scale APE/RPE and fitted-scale regression relative to KLT.
selected_route_scope: A02 XFeat only: delete the exact v2 donor observations without adding candidates, three repeats, same backend, four-arm common support with existing KLT/learned/matched results.
claim_boundary: V2 demonstrates safe frontend action supply but fails backend no-harm on A02. It does not support general superiority over KLT or a modern learned frontend.
